relationships.subject: Lead1 (ZINC000078815430)
relationships.evidence_quote: Lead1 (ZINC000078815430) showed docking score of -9.877 kcal/mol, whereas CBD and β-caryophyllene showed score of -9.664 and -8.499 kcal/mol, respectively.

key_findings: Pharmacophore screening identified six in silico CB2 lead molecules docking better than CBD and beta-caryophyllene.
Lead1 was more stable than CBD in molecular dynamics and had a slightly better MM-GBSA binding energy.
